title: 纽约大学马库斯：AI公司无法自我监管，需要独立审查机制
speaker: Gary Marcus

segments.en: Do you think they can self-regulate? I mean what other safeguards still need to be in place. I mean no, they can't self-regulate
segments.zh: 你认为他们能自我监管吗？还需要哪些保障措施？不，他们无法自我监管。

segments.en: I mean they've shown themselves to be kind of incompetent and cyber security not done the right things
segments.zh: 他们表现出在网络安全方面有些无能，没有做正确的事。

segments.en: Around sandboxing and monitoring. They have released new systems that are harder to monitor when we all know that monitoring is important
segments.zh: 在沙盒和监控方面。他们发布了更难监控的新系统，而众所周知监控很重要。

segments.en: They're clearly not self-regulating themselves adequately. What we really need is something like an FDA procedure where you have to submit your model to external review by independent scientists
segments.zh: 他们显然没有充分自我监管。我们真正需要的是类似FDA的程序，你必须将模型提交给独立科学家进行外部审查。

segments.en: Who don't have skin in the game who say you know do the benefits out way the risks just like we would do if somebody released a new drug. You know a new model might be dangerous
segments.zh: 他们没有利益牵扯，会评估收益是否大于风险，就像有人发布新药时我们会做的那样。新模型可能很危险。

segments.en: In fact the current one is a little bit dangerous the next model might be more dangerous. We can't trust companies that need to IPO where they run out of cash to make the right decisions
segments.zh: 事实上当前模型有点危险，下一个可能更危险。我们不能信任那些需要上市、现金耗尽的公司做出正确决定。

segments.en: They made the wrong decision around GPT-6 Astra
segments.zh: 他们在GPT-6 Astra上做出了错误决定。
